results.method: Every tenth frame plus early, midpoint and endpoint boundaries; fresh canvas per frame with cached resources. Hardware compared directly with pinned output of the same explicit backend at the existing perceptual tier. Lossless PNG transport verified by SHA-256 for every compared frame. Evaluated timing, visibility, transforms and state agree exactly; reverse fresh-render hashes at start/mid/end. WebGL2 also checks reverse seeks on one retained preview across seven sampled positions.
